🌌 The Void Walkers

We are The Void Walkers, a team of curious minds passionate about space, science, technology, and innovation. Our goal is to explore real-world challenges using creativity, teamwork, and technology to build impactful solutions with NASA's open data.

We welcome enthusiastic people skilled in Coding, Software Development, AI/ML, Data Analysis, Earth & Space Science. If you love exploring the unknown and turning ideas into reality, join us on this journey beyond the ordinary!
